schema.stage_choice.stage_ref.label: Which stage is this for?
schema.stage_choice.stage_ref.help: Pick one stage of the plan. It is named by its short name.
schema.stage_choice.chosen_option_ids.it: The id of one option of this stage.
schema.stage_choice.chosen_option_ids.he: The ids of the chosen stage options. Leave empty if you give steps instead.
schema.stage_choice.decision_method.help: It must match the stage's decision method.
schema.stage_choice.decider_role.label: Which role decided?
schema.stage_choice.decider_role.help: A role, never a named person.
schema.stage_choice.authority.label: What gives that role the authority to decide?
schema.stage_choice.rationale.label: Why was this chosen?
schema.stage_choice.rationale.help: Say what weighed most, without naming people.
schema.stage_choice.dissent_notes.label: Notes of disagreement
schema.stage_choice.dissent_notes.help: Short notes on views that differed. Optional.
schema.stage_choice.legal_gate_record.co: The rule or limit the choice was checked against.
schema.stage_choice.legal_gate_record.so: A web address or a rule id with its version.
schema.stage_choice.legal_gate_record.la: The constitution, the local pack, or both.
schema.stage_choice.legal_gate_record.he: The legal check made for this choice. The platform fills it in; you do not. This is not legal advice.
schema.stage_choice.steps.step.label: What is the step?
schema.stage_choice.steps.owner_role.hel: A role, never a named person.
schema.stage_choice.steps.done_criterion: How will anyone know it is done?
A check someone else could make.
schema.stage_choice.steps.label: Steps that follow
schema.stage_choice.steps.help: Each step has an owner role and a way to tell it is done.
